_comment: Step 14.44 (item 117): the Dehgan library of Arak (arak-dhgan-59) holds its catalogue twice since its duplicate record arak-dhgan-abrahym-328 was merged into it (step 14.6): «فهرست نسخه‌های خطی کتابخانه ابراهیم دهگان اراک» (catalogue-27335f850012, two daftars, step 14.15) and «فهرست نسخه‌های خطی کتابخانه استاد ابراهیم دهگان» (catalogue-dc258caef1e6, made for library 328 by catalogs:link-volumes, item 56 batch 5). Both are Sadeq Hazrati's two daftars (Qom 1387). The second is folded into the first; its copies go to the daftar their «ف» names.
